dataset_title: Vinamilk OCR 2011 Vietnamese Scan Diagnostic v3
source: Signed Vietnamese consolidated financial statement page from a third-party preview of Vinamilk's 2011 audited statements; key figures cross-checked against the issuer's official 2011 annual report.
reference_method: PDF text-layer-assisted full-page transcription on the two balance-sheet pages; every line was visually checked against the rendered scans. The income statement remains manually transcribed and officially corroborated.
limitations: Three consecutive pages from one third-party preview packet. All three pages have full text references, but the two balance-sheet transcriptions used the PDF text layer as a transcription aid and were visually checked rather than independently keyed by two annotators. Only the income-statement page is corroborated against the issuer-hosted annual report. Coordinate annotations cover 10 selected balance-sheet rows (20 numeric cells), derived from the source PDF text layer and visually checked; they are not independently click-annotated. Diagnostic only: not representative of Vietnamese scans, not eligible for primary model selection, and not evidence of safe automatic financial publication. OCR output is reused from four completed engine runs on exact-matched source/render hashes; models are not rerun for this reference update.
